nist_controls.title: Information Input Validation
nist_controls.description: Check the validity of the following information inputs: [Assignment: organization-defined information inputs to the system]. The organization defines which information inputs require validity checks and what constitutes a valid input for each type of information input.

nist_controls.title: Information Input Validation | Manual Override Capability
nist_controls.description: Provide a manual override capability for input validation of the following information inputs: [Assignment: organization-defined inputs].

nist_controls.title: Information Input Validation | Review / Resolution of Errors
nist_controls.description: Verify that input validation errors are reviewed and resolved within [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

nist_controls.title: Boundary Protection
nist_controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key internal managed interfaces within the system. Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal organizational networks.

nist_controls.title: Boundary Protection | Access Points
nist_controls.description: Limit the number of external network connections to the system.

nist_controls.title: Boundary Protection | Deny By Default - Allow By Exception
nist_controls.description: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception.

nist_controls.title: Least Functionality
nist_controls.description: Configure the system to provide only mission essential capabilities. Prohibit or restrict the use of the following functions, ports, protocols, software, and/or services.

nist_controls.title: Least Functionality | Periodic Review
nist_controls.description: Review the system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to identify and disable [Assignment: organization-defined functions, ports, protocols, software, and services within the system deemed to be unnecessary].

nist_controls.title: System Monitoring
nist_controls.description: Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks in accordance with the following monitoring objectives and unauthorized local, network, and remote connections.

nist_controls.title: System Monitoring | System-Wide Intrusion Detection System
nist_controls.description: Connect and configure individual intrusion detection tools into a system-wide intrusion detection system.

nist_controls.title: System Monitoring | Automated Tools and Mechanisms for Real-Time Analysis
nist_controls.description: Employ automated tools and mechanisms to support near real-time analysis of events.

nist_controls.title: Least Privilege
nist_controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) which are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

nist_controls.title: Least Privilege | Authorize Access to Security Functions
nist_controls.description: Authorize access for [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or roles] to security functions and security-relevant information.

nist_controls.title: Least Privilege | Non-Privileged Access for Nonsecurity Functions
nist_controls.description: Require that users of system accounts (or roles) with access to [Assignment: organization-defined security functions or security-relevant information] use non-privileged accounts or roles, when accessing nonsecurity functions.

nist_controls.title: Penetration Testing
nist_controls.description: Conduct penetration testing [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

nist_controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
nist_controls.description: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications [Assignment: organization-defined frequency and/or randomly in accordance with organization-defined process] and when new vulnerabilities potentially affecting the system are identified and reported.

nist_controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Update Vulnerabilities to Be Scanned
nist_controls.description: Update the system vulnerabilities to be scanned [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when new vulnerabilities are identified and reported.

nist_controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Update Vulnerabilities to Be Scanned - Prior to New Scan
nist_controls.description: Update the system vulnerabilities to be scanned prior to a new scan or when new vulnerabilities are identified and reported.

nist_controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
nist_controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to create and implement a security and privacy assessment plan.

nist_controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools
nist_controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to follow a documented development process that addresses security and privacy requirements.

regulatory_requirements.title: Security by Design
regulatory_requirements.description: Products with digital elements shall be designed, developed and produced in such a way that they ensure an appropriate level of cybersecurity based on the risks.

regulatory_requirements.title: Vulnerability Handling
regulatory_requirements.description: Products with digital elements shall be delivered without known exploitable vulnerabilities.

regulatory_requirements.title: Cybersecurity Vulnerability Reporting
regulatory_requirements.description: Device manufacturers must report known unpatched vulnerabilities and exploits that could be used to introduce or propagate malware.

regulatory_requirements.title: Security Risk Management
regulatory_requirements.description: Establish and maintain a process to identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity risks.

regulatory_requirements.title: Security Risk Analysis
regulatory_requirements.description: The manufacturer shall document a risk analysis for security vulnerabilities in medical device software.

regulatory_requirements.title: Security Controls Implementation
regulatory_requirements.description: The manufacturer shall implement security controls to reduce security risks to an acceptable level.
